sources.title: MapLibre GeoJSON source and layer specification
sources.supports: GeoJSON data/layers and clustering foundation. Does not supply node geolocation or unrestricted map tiles.

sources.title: MapLibre create and style clusters
sources.supports: Built-in GeoJSON clustering; example external URLs are not a production/offline dependency decision.

sources.title: Natural Earth terms of use
sources.supports: Public-domain terms for published vector/raster map data. Exact dataset archive and checksum remain implementation gate.

sources.title: DB-IP Lite
sources.supports: Candidate locally queried IP geography dataset; CC BY 4.0 attribution, reduced precision. No dataset has been bundled.

sources.title: DB-IP FAQ
sources.supports: Monthly downloadable databases and reduced-accuracy Lite; this does not prove current size or suitability of a specific reader.

sources.title: Android adaptive navigation
sources.supports: Official adaptive navigation approaches; existing Waarp navigation is preserved.

sources.title: Compose Material insets
sources.supports: Official inset handling and double-padding caution; Android form/footer behavior requires actual visual testing.

sources.title: RFC 9293 TCP
sources.supports: TCP connection semantics; local route update is not arbitrary end-to-end session migration.

sources.title: RFC 9000 QUIC
sources.supports: QUIC-specific migration/path validation; not a generic TCP/VPN migration facility.

sources.title: sing-box Selector documentation
sources.supports: Describes selector semantics. Actual Waarp engine pins and downstream usage take precedence.

sources.title: sing-box URLTest documentation
sources.supports: URL probing/selection semantics, not app login/UDP QoE verification.
